question: How can I master the basic controls of Two Button Bounce as a beginner?
answer: To master the basic controls of Two Button Bounce, focus on the two-button mechanic. Use Button A to jump and Button B to dash. For example, in the first level, you need to jump over a gap and then dash to avoid an obstacle. Practice timing your jumps and dashes in sync with the rhythm of the game. A helpful tip is to visualize the buttons as your character's feet—Button A lifts you up, and Button B propels you forward. This analogy can make the controls more intuitive.
